elements.name: Fire
elements.discovery_message: A flicker of heat licks the air. You have discovered Fire!

elements.name: Water
elements.discovery_message: Cool droplets bead on the shell. You have discovered Water!

elements.name: Earth
elements.discovery_message: The ground hums beneath your feet. You have discovered Earth!

elements.name: Air
elements.discovery_message: A breeze stirs from nowhere. You have discovered Air!

elements.name: Light
elements.discovery_message: A soft radiance fills the hatchery. You have discovered Light!

elements.name: Shadow
elements.discovery_message: The lamps dim for a heartbeat. You have discovered Shadow!

elements.name: Steam
elements.discovery_message: A hiss of scalding vapor rises from the Gene Pool! Fire and Water have joined: you have discovered Steam!

elements.name: Magma
elements.discovery_message: The pool glows molten orange and the stones crack! Fire and Earth have fused: you have discovered Magma!

elements.name: Lightning
elements.discovery_message: A crack of thunder splits the hatchery! Fire and Air have collided: you have discovered Lightning!

elements.name: Sun
elements.discovery_message: Blinding gold floods every corner! Fire and Light have merged: you have discovered Sun!

elements.name: Abyssal
elements.discovery_message: The pool burns black and bottomless! Fire and Shadow have entwined: you have discovered Abyssal!

elements.name: Mud
elements.discovery_message: The pool thickens with a rich, earthy squelch! Water and Earth have mingled: you have discovered Mud!

elements.name: Mist
elements.discovery_message: A silver fog rolls out across the floor! Water and Air have blended: you have discovered Mist!

elements.name: Life
elements.discovery_message: Green shoots sprout around the pool's edge! Water and Light have bloomed: you have discovered Life!

elements.name: Poison
elements.discovery_message: The pool turns a sickly, shimmering violet! Water and Shadow have curdled: you have discovered Poison!
